part.text:
I found the red ball and stopped about 0.3 m from it, then called rest. It's close, but I didn't confirm the distance or the heading.

The ball wasn't visible from the start. I had to walk across the room and scan a few times before I spotted it off to the left. I did a final small turn to face it, but the rest call interrupted that turn. The last camera image shows the ball just ahead, slightly right of center in the bottom camera. The robot is now crouched with its motors off.
